citation: Chenevier, The p-adic analytic space of pseudocharacters of a profinite group and pseudorepresentations over arbitrary rings
statement_used: A continuous discrete-valued determinant on a profinite group kills an open normal subgroup's augmentation ideal.
hypotheses_checked: The group is the original compact totally disconnected Hausdorff plus subgroup.
The coefficient ring B/I^a has the discrete topology.
Original IsCont makes each characteristic coefficient locally constant modulo I^a.
No finite coefficient-ring or finitely generated group hypothesis is used.
